row: | psychiatric_care | Psychiatric hospitalization & forensic psychiatry | Inpatient and crisis psychiatric care and the legal side of mental illness: psych wards and 72-hour holds, involuntary commitment, state hospitals and asylums, insanity pleas, competency to stand trial and court-ordered psychiatric evaluations. Talk therapy goes to `mental.therapy` and general hospital care to `health_system.hospitals_access`; the person's condition also takes its own subtopic. "Insane asylum" as a jibe is not health content. | psych ward; placed on a 72-hour psychiatric hold; 5150; Baker Act; involuntary commitment; acquitted by reason of insanity; competent to stand trial; psychiatric evaluation; state psychiatric hospital; institutionalized |

| other_sleep_disorders | Narcolepsy, parasomnias & other sleep disorders | Sleep disorders other than insomnia and sleep-disordered breathing: narcolepsy and hypersomnia, sleepwalking, night terrors, sleep paralysis, REM sleep behaviour disorder and other parasomnias. Trouble sleeping goes to `sleep.insomnia` and apnea to `sleep.apnea_breathing`; "sleepwalking through" something is an idiom, not health content. | narcolepsy; sleep paralysis; sleepwalking; night terrors; diagnosed with REM behavior disorder; parasomnia; sleepwalking defense |

row: | inflammation | Inflammation & oxidative stress as explanations | Inflammation or oxidative stress (free radicals, reactive oxygen species) invoked as a cause of disease or ageing, or as a property of foods and lifestyles, and markers of them. Antioxidant supplements go to `supplements.other_compounds` and antioxidant foods to `food.plant_foods_fiber`. | chronic inflammation; inflammatory foods; CRP; "inflammation is the root of all disease"; inflammaging; neuroinflammation; oxidative stress; reduce these free radicals; reactive oxygen species |

| ocd_personality | OCD, intrusive thoughts, personality & factitious disorders | OCD, intrusive thoughts, clinically framed personality disorders and traits (pathological lying, narcissistic traits), and factitious disorder (Munchausen syndrome; Munchausen by proxy also takes `acute_care.violence_abuse` as medical child abuse). Insults such as calling someone a "narcissist", and "Munchausen" as a loose jibe, are not health content. | OCD; intrusive thoughts; borderline personality disorder; narcissistic personality disorder (as diagnosis); pathological lying; Munchausen syndrome by proxy; factitious disorder |

| digestive_symptoms | Digestive symptoms & functional disorders | Everyday digestive complaints and functional gut disorders, including non-allergic food sensitivities and intolerances. Allergic reactions to food go to `immune.allergies`, elimination diets to `diets.elimination_therapeutic`, and food-sensitivity test kits to `self_tracking.consumer_lab_tests`. | bloating; constipation; reflux; GERD; heartburn; IBS; SIBO; food intolerance; food sensitivities; lactose intolerance; gas |

| dietary_guidelines_caused_obesity | Official diet advice caused the obesity epidemic | **Official dietary guidance (the food pyramid, low-fat advice) caused the obesity and chronic-disease epidemic,** often because grain, sugar or food-industry lobbying shaped it. That dietary fat is harmless is `narrative:saturated_fat_cholesterol_myth`; that the guidelines are industry-controlled, with no harm claim, is `narrative:fda_captured`; deliberate engineering of food is `narrative:food_engineered_to_harm`. | the food pyramid ignited the obesity epidemic; the low-fat era made us fat; the food pyramid was a lobbying instrument; blow up the food pyramid | policy |

| saturated_fat_cholesterol_myth | Saturated fat and cholesterol are not harmful | **Saturated fat, dietary cholesterol or high blood (LDL) cholesterol do not cause heart disease.** The diet-heart or lipid hypothesis is called wrong or fraudulent, and cholesterol is called a harmless "beacon" or repair molecule. Statin harm or uselessness is `narrative:statins_harmful`. | Ancel Keys fraud; butter is back; sugar industry blamed fat; LDL doesn't matter; the plaque lie; cholesterol is not the bad guy; insulin, not LDL, causes heart disease | food |

| mind_cures_disease | The mind can cure serious disease | **Thoughts, beliefs, meditation or emotional release can cure serious physical disease such as cancer,** making medical treatment secondary; remissions are credited to mindset or manifesting. That emotions affect health in general is `topic:stress.mind_body`; a named herb or protocol for cancer is `narrative:natural_remedy_cures_cancer`. | you have the power to heal yourself of anything; heal yourself of cancer; the chemo wasn't working, so they turned to belief in themselves; healings at Dispenza retreats | stress |

| normal_labs_miss_disease | "Normal" lab results hide real disease | **Standard lab tests and reference ranges routinely miss thyroid, hormone or metabolic dysfunction, so people told their labs are normal are often sick.** Full panels and narrow "optimal ranges" are said to be needed. One patient's missed diagnosis without the general claim is `topic:health_system.medical_errors`. | only testing TSH; optimal ranges versus reference ranges; your labs are normal but you're not; demand a full thyroid panel; undiagnosed by six different doctors | procedures |

| trauma_stored_in_body | Trauma is stored in the body | **Psychological trauma is physically stored in the body's tissues and causes symptoms or illness until it is released,** usually through somatic, breath or bodywork practices. That trauma or stress affects health in general is a topic (`topic:mental.trauma_ptsd`, `topic:stress.mind_body`), not this narrative. | the body keeps the score; how trauma is stored in the body; trauma stored in the hips; issues in the tissues; releasing stored trauma | stress |

| germ_theory_denial | Germ theory is false / terrain theory | **Germs, or a specific pathogen, do not cause the disease attributed to them.** Viruses are said not to exist or not to be contagious and the "terrain" is what matters, or a named pathogen is denied its role (HIV does not cause AIDS). | terrain theory; viruses don't exist; Pasteur recanted; HIV doesn't cause AIDS; Duesberg's questions about HIV | infectious |
